---

**What** — the feature or milestone, and which roadmap milestone it belongs to (if any).

**Why now** — the measured pain or phase dependency that triggers it (this repo builds
deferred features only when a trigger fires — name the trigger).

**Fence** — what it may touch, what it must not (seams, determinism contract, hash oracle).

**Done-condition** — observable, testable definition of done (window opens, hash matches,
ctest green, screenshot shows X).
